walkthrough: Goal: copy colour combinations the way V大 picks them for 色彩组合 and the way I copied them before the app: a crop of a real picture with distinct colours, a corner of an abstract oil painting or of a rusted old thing, never a concrete object (the author, 2026-10-30: the generated ones varied too little). Squint, set the overall tone, lay the big blocks with a big brush, then smaller, keeping weak contrasts weak; then see area by area how my colours differ and whether I made a weak contrast strong.

Entry: All units from the home shows unit 1 (Lines, Combined lines, Colours) and the next lesson; colour combinations come in unit 2, and a lesson of them needs a pack holding crops (combinations copy crops of real pictures). Home, the practice options.

Import practice pack…: the harness answers with its test crops, pictures of known areas standing in for the colour combinations pack's crops and the composition pack's corners (the real packs are built by `cargo practice-pack` and judged on their sheets). The notice: the pack's crops come up in colour combinations.

A lesson of Colour combinations at level 1 from the home holds one combination, its How first: still played on S82's generated example, the pens in their order (Fill frame, Big, Small, Soft), and its line on what it trains naming the corner of a rusted thing or an abstract painting.

The combination: the crop in the left frame (the pack's picture, its credit under the frame when its licence asks for one), an empty frame of its shape beside it. The tools as S100's: the wheel, Fill frame, Undo, Redo, Big, Small, Soft and the eyedropper; the original refuses the eyedropper until Compare.
Copy: a dull tone filled, then strokes of Big in a colour of my own, one of them across where two areas meet; Undo takes the last stroke back, Redo returns it.

Compare: the crop over my copy at half strength under Original shown; a chip per area the pack found in the crop (its colour over mine); the chosen area's pair on the wheel and in the colour table, its outline on both frames; where my copy made one of the crop's weak contrasts strong, that edge red. Another chip shows its area. The eyedropper on the crop compares the crop's own colour there with mine.
Finish, That's all for today, and a second lesson of Colour combinations: another crop, none twice while others are left. Home leaves it under way; Start on the home reopens it at its crop.
Home, and a third lesson of Colour combinations: a third crop.
Chinese: All tools, Actions, 中文: the tools in Chinese; s101-real-crops-zh runs this walk-through on a Chinese tablet, the card, the chips (色块) and the table in Chinese.

Not here: the real packs' crops (judged on their contact sheets under artifacts/packs/); combinations of my own pictures, their answer made on the device (a candidate); a record of a generated combination from 1.18.1 and before, which keeps its strokes and numbers and shows its picture made again from its seed (the app's and the store's tests).
